title: Design System: π Finder — Neon Spectrum

motion.name: result-reveal
motion.purpose: Reveal result with blur and rise.

pageFlow.navigation: Native relative links; Home, Explorer and Leaderboard in header; Result follows a completed scan. Mobile navigation occupies a row beneath the brand.
pageFlow.progress: Search and Result expose three journey stages with aria-current=step.
pageFlow.resultLayout: Report and explanation use a 1.65fr/1fr grid, stacked at 650px.
pageFlow.scanLayout: Hide the coordinate form and center the terminal within an 820px workspace during the four-second scan.

piSigns.surface: result.html sidebar; stacked below report on mobile
piSigns.components: Native reveal button, ten-point SVG selector dial, sign reading, ruled lucky-number row, native details catalog.
piSigns.palette: Existing cyan, muted, text, line and navy tokens.
piSigns.motion: Existing revealed animation; global reduced-motion override applies.
piSigns.truth: Actual next decimal digit selects a fictional reading; no assigned sign when match or following digit is unavailable.

narrative.overview: Violet canvas with pink and blue ambient illumination. Pink actions and selections, blue mathematical data, gold scores. Minimal copy and opaque reading surfaces preserve usability.
keyCharacteristics: Cyan instrument readouts on deep navy.
Thin borders and restrained luminous depth.
Distinct display, instructional and mathematical type roles.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks interactive state, mathematical discovery or the instrument's focal geometry.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Use mono for sequences, positions and instrument metadata; use sans-serif for explanations and form choices.

rules.name: The Instrument Light Rule
rules.body: Glow reinforces the scientific instrument and active discovery; panel boundaries remain thin and precise.

dos: Do use cyan to connect primary actions, selected states and mathematical discoveries.
Do retain the separate display, instruction and data type roles.
Do stack the workspace and retain visible keyboard focus on narrow screens.
Do honor reduced-motion preference for scan and reveal effects.
donts: Don't turn local leaderboard medal colors into competing brand accents.
Don't replace the instrument's fine framing with hard offset shadows.
Don't inherit the build's remaining decorative uppercase kickers or tiny mobile metadata as reusable patterns; they are recorded defects, not system rules.
